description: Source code for the ClassDefinition class in the WebKitBrowser InjectedBundle, managing JavaScript class definitions and functions.

classes.name: ClassDefinition
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript class definition with methods to add or remove functions, and manage class instances.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::ClassDefinition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes class name and extension name based on an identifier, converting to uppercase and lowercase respectively.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::getClassMap
methods.description: Returns a singleton map of class definitions.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Instance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of a class definition by class name.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Add
methods.description: Adds a JavaScriptFunction to the class's custom functions list.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Remove
methods.description: Removes a JavaScriptFunction from the class's custom functions list.
